personalInfo.name: Abdullah Saleh Robin
personalInfo.title: Senior Backend & Full-Stack Engineer
personalInfo.bio:
Senior Backend & Full-Stack Engineer with 9 years building enterprise systems in Java with Spring Boot and in .NET with C#, across e-commerce, healthcare, compliance and public-sector platforms.

I designed, built and ran an election-data platform end to end that processed 230,000+ scanned PDFs and 177M+ records, and served roughly 10M searches inside a 15-day national election window.

At Optimizely I co-engineered SpireWiz, cutting upgrade cycles by up to 80% and reclaiming 600+ developer hours a year. Microsoft Certified.
personalInfo.about: I have nine years of professional experience building scalable enterprise applications across e-commerce, compliance, healthcare and public-sector domains, working with distributed, cross-timezone teams across the US and Canada. My work centres on Java and Spring Boot back-ends, cloud-native .NET, and Angular and React front-ends, together with applied AI: integrating LLMs into production systems with schema-constrained output and fallback handling. Based in Germany, available immediately, and authorized to work without sponsorship.

experience.description: Customized and maintained Optimizely Configured Commerce (B2B), collaborating with cross-functional international teams across the US and Canada. Co-engineered SpireWiz, an AI-powered upgrade automation tool that cut upgrade cycles by up to 80% and reclaimed 600+ developer hours a year. Delivered the platform's first Classic to Spire storefront migrations and reviewed 100+ pull requests across 15+ client projects.

Implemented Socket.IO for a persistent connection manager. Managed edge cases like lost connections, automatic re-connections, and real-time data synchronization. Developed skills in real-time data handling and troubleshooting in a fast-paced environment.

Worked as a senior full-stack developer mainly in Java with Spring Boot, alongside .NET Core, Angular and TypeScript. Led development teams and guided their career growth. Participated in client meetings, collected requirements, analyzed system needs, and prioritized tasks. Handled database design, built complex queries, and analyzed technical problems to design solutions.

Worked as a full-stack developer mainly in Java with Spring Boot, alongside .NET Core and Angular. Practiced agile methodologies for improving software quality at each release. Initialized projects from scratch using design principles and standard coding conventions. Created highly readable, clean and easily maintainable source code.

education.description: CGPA 3.41 out of 4.00. Focused on software engineering principles and web development, with coding competitions alongside coursework.

projects.title: Optimizely Configured Commerce
projects.description: Enterprise-grade B2B commerce platform with advanced product configuration and streamlined checkout. Enhanced performance by 35% and modernized UI for better UX. Led code reviews to maintain standards with cross-functional teams.

projects.title: Parsing Project
projects.description: Election-data processing platform for 340+ client organisations in Bangladesh, in production 2021 to January 2026. I designed, built and operated it: an OCR and LLM document pipeline over a 65M-record PostgreSQL database, served by two Angular SPAs on Kubernetes. It processed 230,000+ scanned PDFs and 177M+ voter entries, and served roughly 10M searches during a 15-day national-election window.

projects.title: National Skills Authority (NSDA)
projects.description: Platform for 100,000+ training providers with role-based access control and payment gateway integration. Led the developer team to ensure scalability through loosely coupled components and automated backups.

projects.title: Shastho Batayon (16263)
projects.description: Telemedicine platform serving 30M+ users with remote diagnoses. Built scalable, redundant CRM handling 100k+ calls daily during pandemic peak. Contributed 20k+ lines of API and frontend code to the core solution.

projects.title: National Equipment Identity Register
projects.description: Highly scalable, reliable microservices for national equipment registry. Created Bash scripts to automate deployment of 40 redundant services, significantly reducing manual configuration errors and deployment time.

projects.title: Shastho Batayon Corona Bot
projects.description: Facebook Messenger bot delivering COVID-19 information and self-assessment. Integrated third-party APIs for live statistics and achieved high throughput with optimized message handling and response generation.

projects.title: Covid-19 Patient Management
projects.description: Dynamic telehealth CRM serving 10,000+ patients daily during pandemic peak. Implemented fully configurable questionnaire system and versatile admin reporting tool for real-time data analysis and decision support.

projects.title: E-Prescription Service (gRPC Microservice)
projects.description: A shared Spring Boot microservice delivering e-prescriptions to patients by SMS, used across several national healthcare platforms and sending around 50,000 prescriptions a day. New SMS vendors were added through configuration alone, with no backend code change. Delivery adapted to the handset: smartphones received one message, feature phones received ordered parts.

projects.title: Trendy Bot (Multi-Tenant Facebook Commerce Platform)
projects.description: A multi-tenant platform automating Facebook pages for commerce, built on .NET across four services with a Node.js edge for the Messenger integration. Served more than 50 pages from a single deployment, sustaining 800 concurrent messages per second, with per-tenant configuration, scheduled broadcast campaigns and in-chat checkout.

projects.title: Shared File Service (gRPC Microservice)
projects.description: A shared microservice handling file upload and download for other services, consumed independently by two national platforms. Callable over gRPC, storing small to large files concurrently on server storage, deployed on premises.

projects.title: Telenor Health
projects.description: A second deployment of the national telemedicine platform for a separate commercial venture, running the same core codebase with client-specific tuning. This is what proved the contact-centre platform was a reusable product rather than one bespoke build.

projects.title: Point of Sale (Open Source)
projects.description: An ASP.NET MVC point-of-sale web application covering products, barcodes, suppliers, purchases, sales and printed receipts. Published open source and picked up by other developers as a reference implementation. An earlier desktop version was built in WPF on a three-layer separation with LINQ to SQL and Crystal Reports.

projects.title: Makkah Hotel Management System
projects.description: Multi-tenant hotel management and booking platform, designed and built end to end. Tenant isolation runs across four independent layers: HTTP middleware, Entity Framework Core global query filters on reads, a SaveChanges interceptor on writes, and PostgreSQL row-level security on the tables themselves. Onion architecture with domain-driven design, and a Next.js front end in strict TypeScript with right-to-left Arabic support.

projects.title: Digital-Asset Platform (Real-Time Layer)
projects.description: Real-time communication layer for a digital-asset platform, built for a US client. Persistent client-server connectivity over SignalR and Socket.IO, with connection-management workflows covering lost connections, reconnections and the edge cases around live user interaction.

featured.title: SpireWiz
featured.tagline: AI-powered upgrade automation for Optimizely Configured Commerce.
featured.description: Optimizely Configured Commerce upgrades were a manual, repetitive drag on every client project. We put the OpenAI Platform API into three-way merge conflict analysis so the tool proposes resolutions instead of engineers hand-reconciling each one, and folded it into the delivery workflow across enterprise B2B projects.

featured.title: Parsing Project
featured.tagline: Election-data processing platform for 340+ client organisations in Bangladesh.
featured.description: In production from 2021 to January 2026. An OCR and LLM document pipeline over a 65M-record PostgreSQL database, served by two Angular SPAs on Kubernetes. The heavy compute was deliberately pushed to background workers and the browser so the API stayed a thin store-and-serve layer, which is what let it hold up through a national election.
